name: Electronics Source (es.co.th) Parts Library
description: Symbols, footprints, 3D models, and sourcing fields (ES P/N, price, stock) for Electronics Source (es.co.th) parts.
description_full: A KiCad library of Electronics Source (es.co.th) parts. Symbols carry ES P/N, ES_URL, list price (THB, VAT-exclusive), and per-warehouse stock with a Stock_Date so freshness is always legible. Auto-generated for passives and discretes; hand-drawn and stock-patched for ICs, connectors, and modules. See the project README for scope and exclusions. Prices are list, VAT-exclusive, and dated at build time -- not live.
